title: SRE Command Center — Operations & Incident Response
description: Triage view: alerts → golden signals → k8s → logs/events → traces.

panels.title: Situation — what is broken right now?

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_status_ready{condition="false", namespace=~"$namespace"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase!~"Succeeded|Failed"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: All firing alerts. Follow the runbook link in Slack/PagerDuty for the response procedure.

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Click an exemplar dot to jump to the trace in Tempo.

panels.title: Error-budget burn rate (1h / 6h)
panels.description: 1 = spending budget exactly on schedule. 6x pages after 6h, 14.4x pages after 1h.

targets.expr: sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name=~"$service", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])) / sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name=~"$service"}[5m]))

panels.title: Service map (live)
panels.description: Built from the OTel servicegraph connector. Red rings = errors.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval])))
topk(10, sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", image!=""}))

panels.title: CPU throttling (top 10)
panels.description: > 25 % throttling usually means the CPU limit is too low.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Error logs ($namespace)
panels.description: Expand a line and click 'View trace' to jump to the request in Tempo.

panels.title: Kubernetes warning events
panels.description: FailedScheduling, BackOff, Unhealthy, OOMKilling… collected by the otel-cluster collector.

panels.title: Recent failed requests (traces)
panels.description: Errors are always kept by tail sampling. Click a trace ID to open it.
